async function run(items, operation, config) {
	const width = 1;
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	await mapLimit(items, width, operation);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	const execute = () => mapLimit(items, width, operation);
	await execute();
	const concurrency = 1;
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	await mapLimit(items, operation, { concurrency });
	let mutable = 1;
	const deferred = () => mapLimit(items, mutable, operation);
	mutable = 4;
	await deferred();
	let limit = 1;
	({ limit } = config);
	await mapLimit(items, operation, { limit });
	await Promise.all(items.map((width) => mapLimit(items, width, operation)));
}
